title: HTML 实体解析器
summary: 把文本中六种指定 HTML 字符实体转换为对应字符，其他内容保持不变。
insight: 从左到右扫描；在 & 位置尝试匹配已知实体，命中后一次消费完整实体。这样 & 的结果不会被再次级联解析。
pitfalls: 只解析题目列出的六种实体
一次扫描避免重复解码
未知的 & 开头文本原样保留

solutions.title: 单次实体匹配
solutions.idea: 扫描到 & 时尝试固定实体表并跳过已消费字符。
steps: 准备实体字符串与替换值数组
位置 i 若匹配某实体则追加替换值并前进实体长度
否则追加当前字符并前进一位

code.java: class Solution { public String entityParser(String text){String[] entities={""","'","&",">","<","⁄"},values={"\"","'","&",">","<","/"};StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0;i<text.length();){boolean matched=false;if(text.charAt(i)=='&')for(int j=0;j<entities.length;j++)if(text.startsWith(entities[j],i)){answer.append(values[j]);i+=entities[j].length();matched=true;break;}if(!matched)answer.append(text.charAt(i++));}return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun entityParser(text:String):String{val entities=listOf(""" to "\"","'" to "'","&" to "&",">" to ">","<" to "<","⁄" to "/");val answer=StringBuilder();var i=0;while(i<text.length){val match=if(text[i]=='&')entities.firstOrNull{text.startsWith(it.first,i)}else null;if(match==null)answer.append(text[i++])else{answer.append(match.second);i+=match.first.length}};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string entityParser(string text){vector<pair<string,string>> entities={{""","\""},{"'","'"},{"&","&"},{">",">"},{"<","<"},{"⁄","/"}};string answer;for(int i=0;i<(int)text.size();){bool matched=false;if(text[i]=='&')for(auto& [entity,value]:entities)if(text.compare(i,entity.size(),entity)==0){answer+=value;i+=entity.size();matched=true;break;}if(!matched)answer+=text[i++];}return answer;} };
